edges.reason: tokenName is stored into state variable name by the constructor.
tokenSymbol is stored into state variable symbol by the constructor.
total is consumed by the constructor to derive supply.
msg.sender becomes the initial holder of the minted supply.
total is multiplied and exponentiated in total * 10**uint256(decimals).
Result of the scaled multiplication is written into totalSupply_.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply_.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
totalSupply returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
balances is read by balanceOf.
msg.sender is the debited balance owner in transfer.
receiver is the credited address in transfer.
numTokens is the amount processed by transfer.
numTokens is an operand of the sub/add balance updates in transfer.
SafeMath.sub backs the balance subtraction performed by transfer.
SafeMath.add backs the balance addition performed by transfer.
Sub/add results are written back to the balances mapping in transfer.
transfer mutates the balances state variable.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
delegate is the spender key in approve.
numTokens is the allowance value set by approve.
approve writes into the allowed state variable.
owner is the first key read by allowance.
delegate is the second key read by allowance.
allowance reads the allowed state variable.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
owner is the address debited by transferFrom.
buyer is the address credited by transferFrom.
numTokens is the amount processed by transferFrom.
numTokens is an operand of the sub/add balance and allowance updates.
SafeMath.sub backs the deductions performed by transferFrom.
SafeMath.add backs the credit performed by transferFrom.
Sub/add results are written back to the balances mapping in transferFrom.
numTokens is compared against the allowance and balance in the require checks.
The allowed mapping is read by the access-control require in transferFrom.
Failed require conditions abort transferFrom before any state mutation.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances state variable.
Parameter a is the minuend in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a is an addend in SafeMath.add.
Parameter b is an addend in SafeMath.add.
Local c = a + b is computed without SafeMath inside SafeMath.add.
